historical_record.description: Standing in a photograph of Mars Street from Kite Hill (OpenSFHistory wnp27.6091).
Visible above the earthquake refugee camp at Corbett and Mars (OpenSFHistory wnp37.00189).
Photographed at close range with 56 and 64 Mars (San Francisco History Center, SFPL).
Greatly altered; a 1921 photograph taken from 17th Street still shows it unaltered (OpenSFHistory wnp36.02481).

building.conflict: The assessor records 1900; the c. 1895 photograph shows the house already standing.
